source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of kidney failure and dialysis (PDF 20-22).

blocks.text: Kidney (renal) failure aisi halat hai jis mein gurde khoon se fuzlaat chhanne aur jism mein pani aur namak ka tawazun qaboo karne ki salahiyat kho dete hain. Chronic (purani) kidney failure lambe arse mein aahista aahista banti hai aur theek nahin hoti (irreversible). Is ki wajah aksar koi andar ki bimari hoti hai, jaise diabetes (sugar), high blood pressure, ya gurde ki bimari (purani infection, glomeruli ki sozish waghera).

Acute (achanak) kidney failure ko kidney injury bhi kehte hain. Yeh achanak hoti hai aur aksar ilaj se theek ho jati hai. Is ki wajahen ho sakti hain: gurde ki infection, peshab ke raste mein rukawat (pathri, bladder cancer ya bare hue prostate ki wajah se), kuch dawaen jaise NSAIDs (dard ki kuch aam goliyan), aur renal arteries ya arterioles mein khoon ke lothre (blood clots).

Renal dialysis kidney failure ka woh ilaj hai jis mein metabolic fuzlaat masnooi (artificial) tareeqon se khoon se chhane jate hain. Renal dialysis ki do aam qismein hain: haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis.

Haemodialysis mein khoon ko jism ke bahar dialyzer naam ke aale se guzar kar fuzlaat nikale jate hain. Yeh aala ek qisam ka filter hai jis mein semipermeable membrane (sirf chhote zarron ko guzarne dene wali jhilli, cellulose se bani) hoti hai.

Is ilaj mein ek catheter (patli nali) artery mein dala jata hai, aam taur par baazu mein. Phir khoon dialyzer se guzara jata hai, jis mein dialysate naam ka khaas mayi bhi hota hai. Jab khoon dialyzer se guzarta hai to dialysate fuzlaat, pani aur namak ko khoon se bahar aane par majboor karta hai; yeh madde semipermeable membrane se guzar kar dialysate mein ghul jate hain. Phir saaf khoon vein mein dale gaye doosre catheter ke zariye jism mein wapas chala jata hai.

blocks.alt: Khoon baazu ki artery se laal nali mein nikal kar dialyzer se neeche guzarta aur vein mein wapas jata hai. Dialyzer ke andar khoon dialysis membrane ki laal nalyon mein neeche behta hai aur dialysate un ke darmiyan oopar. Taaza (fresh) dialysate neeche wali thaili se aata hai aur istemal shuda (used) dialysate doosri thaili mein jata hai.

blocks.title: Ulti simtein kyun?
blocks.text: Dialyzer mein khoon aur dialysate ulti simton mein behte hain. Membrane ke poore raaste khoon se milne wala dialysate khoon se zyada taaza hota hai, to fuzlaat poori lambai mein bahar diffuse hote rehte hain, bajaye is ke ke dono mayaat aadhe raaste barabar ho jayen.

Peritoneal dialysis mein peritoneal membrane istemal hoti hai, jo pait ki cavity (abdominal cavity) ki andar ki tah hai. Is amal mein 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate catheter ke zariye mareez ke pait mein dala jata hai. Dialysate 4 se 6 ghante pait mein rehne diya jata hai. Is dauran peritoneum ki khoon ki capillaries se fuzlaat aur zaid mayi dialysate mein aa jate hain. Phir dialysate pait se nikal kar phenk diya jata hai. Fuzlaat aur zaid mayi achhi tarah nikalne ke liye yeh amal din mein kai baar dohraya jata hai.
Dialysis ke masail (Problems associated with dialysis)
Dialysis kidney failure ke mareezon ki jaan bacha sakta hai, lekin is ilaj ke saath kai masail bhi hain.

items: Dialysis ke liye khoon tak rasai (access) chahiye, jis se infections ka khatra barhta hai.
Hypotension yaani kam blood pressure haemodialysis ki ek aam pecheedgi (complication) hai.
Namak ki miqdar badalne se dialysis ke dauran muscles mein khinchao (cramps) ho sakta hai.
Dialysis se anaemia (khoon ki kami) ho sakti hai, jis se thakan aur kamzori hoti hai.
Agar bohat zyada mayi bohat jaldi nikal diya jaye to pani ki kami (dehydration) ya kam blood pressure ho sakta hai.
Dialysis ka ilaj jazbati taur par mushkil ho sakta hai. Mareez ilaj ki mushkilon se pareshani (anxiety), udasi (depression) ya bojh mehsoos kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Dhar ka pehlu se manzar, peeche reerh ki haddi. Peritoneal cavity ko peritoneal membrane (peeli) gherti hai jis mein khoon ki nalyan (laal) hain, aur cavity dialysate se bhari hai. Catheter pait ki deewar se bahar Y jor tak jata hai: oopar taaza dialysate ki thaili, neeche istemal shuda dialysate ki. Chhote teer fuzlaat (wastes) ka khoon se dialysate mein jana dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peeli lakeer peritoneal membrane hai aur us ke andar laal lakeer khoon ki nalyan. Dialysate catheter se cavity mein bhara jata hai; membrane ki nalyon se fuzlaat aur zaid pani chhote teeron ki simt mein dialysate mein aate hain. Kuch ghanton baad yeh dialysate neeche wali thaili mein nikal diya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Haemodialysis aur peritoneal dialysis ka muqabla kijiye: har aik mein filter kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Haemodialysis mein filter jism ke bahar dialyzer ki cellulose semipermeable membrane hai; peritoneal dialysis mein mareez ka apna peritoneum, pait ki andaruni teh.

items: Chronic kidney failure: aahista, theek nahin hoti (diabetes, high blood pressure, gurde ki bimari). Acute: achanak, aksar theek ho jati hai (infection, rukawat, NSAIDs, lothre).
Haemodialysis: khoon jism ke bahar dialyzer (cellulose ki semipermeable membrane) se guzarta hai; fuzlaat dialysate mein jate hain.
Peritoneal dialysis: 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate pait mein 4 se 6 ghante; peritoneal membrane filter ka kaam karti hai.
Masail: infection, kam blood pressure, cramps, anaemia, pani ki kami, jazbati mushkilat.
